ModMetaData.author: mcocdaa
ModMetaData.description:
[h1]RimMind - Personality (v2.0)[/h1] Big-Five psychological profiling and probabilistic state-transition reflection system for RimWorld colonists. Endows every colonist with a persistent inner world, generating dynamic personality Thoughts and introspective soliloquies that influence mood, behavior, and advisor decisions.
[b]v2.0 Clean Architecture & RimWorld 1.6 / 1.7 Dual-Version Support:[/b] [list] [*][b]RimWorld 1.6 & 1.7 (Waylith / .NET 10) Ready[/b]: Native multi-target compilation supporting both RimWorld 1.6 (.NET Framework 4.8) and RimWorld 1.7 (.NET 10 / Harmony 2.x & 3.x). [*][b]v2.0 Big-Five Psychometric & Probabilistic State Engine[/b]: Replaces rigid timers with organic environmental triggers (06:00 Dawn Sunrise, Skygazing, Shared Recreation, Traumatic Mood Swings). Note: v1.x saves are not compatible with v2.0. [*][b]Loose-Coupled Thought Event Bus[/b]: Broadcasts psychological shifts to [code]RimMind-Advisor[/code] and [code]RimMind-Core[/code] Zone 2 context without direct cross-mod coupling. [/list]
[h2]What Is RimMind[/h2] RimMind is an enterprise-grade, AI-powered RimWorld mod suite. Integrated with Large Language Models (LLM), it transforms colonists into self-reflecting agents with distinct personalities, three-tier memories, natural spoken dialogues, autonomous mechanisms, and dynamic storytelling.

[h2]Core Features[/h2] [list] [*][b]Big-Five Cognitive Profiling[/b] - Maps vanilla RimWorld traits (e.g., Bloodlust, Optimist, Neurotic) onto continuous psychometric axes ([i]Openness, Conscientiousness, Extraversion, Agreeableness, Neuroticism[/i]). [*][b]Probabilistic State-Transition Reflections[/b] - Colonists reflect naturally during 06:00 Dawn Sunrise (30% chance), Skygazing/Solitude (40% chance), Shared Recreation (25% chance), and Traumatic Mood Swings (50% chance). [*][b]Dynamic Mood Thought Injection[/b] - Generates 1 to 3 contextual Personality Thoughts (intensity -3 to +3, mapping to -10 to +10 mood offset) injected into independent mood slots without overwriting one another. [*][b]Bio Personality Tab & Player Editing[/b] - View AI psychological narratives directly in the pawn Bio tab, customize personality descriptions, work preferences, and social tendencies, and use [b]Shape Voting[/b] to guide future AI evaluations. [/list]
[h2]Trigger Conditions & Mood Scaling[/h2] [table] [tr][th]Trigger Type[/th][th]Description[/th][/tr] [tr][td]06:00 Dawn & Daily Cycle[/td][td]Morning reflection as daylight returns, with staggered offset to avoid simultaneous bursts[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Injury & Illness[/td][td]Reacts to severe combat wounds or chronic health conditions[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Skill Milestones[/td][td]Reflects on personal growth when skill levels advance[/td][/tr] [tr][td]Major Colony Events & Bereavement[/td][td]Reacts to raids, harvests, or the loss of bonded companions[/td][/tr] [/table]
[table] [tr][th]AI Intensity[/th][th]Mood Offset[/th][th]Psychological State[/th][/tr] [tr][td]+3 / +2 / +1[/td][td]+10 / +3 / +1[/td][td]Inspired, hopeful, or quietly content[/td][/tr] [tr][td]0[/td][td]0[/td][td]Emotionally balanced observation[/td][/tr] [tr][td]-1 / -2 / -3[/td][td]-1 / -3 / -10[/td][td]Troubled, anxious, or deeply distressed[/td][/tr] [/table]
[h2]Frequently Asked Questions[/h2] [b]Q: Can I customize a colonist's personality manually?[/b] A: Yes! Open the Personality panel in the pawn's Bio tab to edit traits, work habits, and social tendencies, or upvote/downvote AI assessments via Shape Voting.
[b]Q: How does Personality interact with Advisor and Dialogue?[/b] A: Active Personality profiles and Thoughts are injected into Core's Zone 2 context and broadcast to [code]RimMind-Advisor[/code], ensuring dialogues and action proposals reflect each colonist's true inner state.
